title: Why Aecos founder Joshua Eufinger chose Every to incorporate his startup
summary: Aecos founder Joshua Eufinger explains how his architecture practice inspired Aecos and why he chose Every to incorporate.
body_markdown:
## Key takeaways


- Aecos started with a problem Joshua Eufinger knew from his own architecture practice: getting project files and information to the right people took too much manual work. At Eufinger Studio, his team built AI workflows to make that easier. Those tools grew into Aecos, software for architecture, engineering, and construction teams.
- Joshua had used LegalZoom for previous companies. For Aecos, he wanted a company structure suitable for potential startup investment.
- When it came time to turn Aecos into a company, Joshua was still figuring out how far he wanted to take it and whether he would raise money. He chose Every to incorporate because the sign-up felt straightforward and the cost made it a low-risk decision.


## Why did you choose Every?


**Joshua Eufinger:** I chose Every because it was the easiest. That’s the honest answer. I think the fact that it was free and I wasn’t sure what Aecos was going to turn into. I wasn’t sure if I wanted to raise, if I wanted to turn it into a company, so it seemed very low risk. So the offer that you guys had going was very tempting. And then the whole, you know, a lot of the times you start the process of creating a company and you get stuck. And so with Every, I didn’t feel for a single second like I was getting stuck. The sign-up flow was just so easy and so straightforward. Yeah, I really liked that about Every.


## What alternatives did you consider?


**Joshua Eufinger:** In the past, I had used LegalZoom to create companies. And I thought, like, LegalZoom wasn’t working anymore. And I wanted to make sure that, and actually I think this one is the most important, I wanted to make sure that I’m creating the kind of company that tech startups and investors would want to invest in. And Every just fit that description perfectly. And that’s why, that’s probably the biggest reason why I chose Every.


## What other Every products do you expect to use?


**Joshua Eufinger:** So, so which, which features like banking or payroll do we feel like we’ll be using rather soon? We think that we’ll probably be using payroll really soon and banking, of course, because it’s kind of like the core of our finances. So I think those two are very important to have and Every has those.


## Tell us about Aecos.


**Joshua Eufinger:** Aecos originated out of workflow problems that we were facing inside of my own architecture firm, Eufinger Studio. And more recently, we’ve been bringing on outside customers to help us improve Aecos. Aecos creates AI, uses AI to unify the context and with the help of AI make those workflows automatic so that a person doesn’t have to do them anymore.
